title: Embedded Linux Senior Software Engineer - Optimisation
description:
Work across the full Linux stack from kernel through GUI to optimise Ubuntu, the world's most widely used Linux desktop and server, for the latest silicon.

The role is a fast‑paced, problem‑solving role that's challenging yet very exciting. The right candidate must be resourceful, articulate, and able to deliver on a wide variety of solutions across PC and IoT technologies. Our teams partner with specialist engineers from major silicon companies to integrate next‑generation features and performance enhancements for upcoming hardware.

Location

This is a Globally remote role

What your day will look like

  • Design and implement the best Ubuntu integration for the latest IoT and server‑class hardware platforms and software stacks
  • Work with partners to deliver a delightful, optimised, first class Ubuntu experience on their platforms
  • Take a holistic approach to the Ubuntu experience on partner platforms with inputs on technical plans, testing strategy, quality metrics
  • Participate as technical lead on complex customer engagements involving complete system architectures from cloud to edge
  • Help our customers integrate their apps, SDKs, build device OS images, optimise applications with Ubuntu Core, Desktop and Server
  • Work with the most advanced operating systems and application technologies available in the enterprise world.

Joining Canonical, you will partner with bright minds from all over the world, and work with an exciting set of new technologies in a fast growing company with a truly unique and ambitious vision to build a better platform with free software. You will work with customers on exciting IoT and server platforms and technologies, built to support different verticals: from robots to data centres, from telco to retail.

What we are looking for in you

  • You love technology and working with brilliant people
  • You have a Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, STEM or similar
  • You have experience with Linux packaging (Debian, RPM, Yocto)
  • You have experience working with open source communities and licences
  • You have experience working with C, C++
  • You can work in a globally distributed team through self‑discipline and self‑motivation.

Additional Skills That You Might Also Bring

  • Experience with graphics stacks
  • Good understanding of networking - TCP/IP, DHCP, HTTP/REST
  • Basic understanding of security best practices in IoT or server environments
  • Good communication skills, ideally public speaking experience
  • IoT / Embedded experience – from board and SoC, BMCs, bootloaders and firmware to OS, through apps and services
  • Some experience with Docker/OCI containers/K8s

What we offer you

Your base pay will depend on various factors including your geographical location, level of experience, knowledge and skills. In addition to the benefits above, certain roles are also eligible for additional benefits and rewards including annual bonuses and sales incentives based on revenue or utilisation. Our compensation philosophy is to ensure equity right across our global workforce.

In addition to a competitive base pay, we provide all team members with additional benefits, which reflect our values and ideals. Please note that additional benefits may apply depending on the work location and, for more information on these, you can ask in the later stages of the recruitment process.

  • Fully remote working environment - we've been working remotely since 2004!
  • Personal learning and development budget of 2,000USD per annum
  • Annual compensation review
  • Recognition rewards
  • Annual holiday leave
  • Parental Leave
  • Employee Assistance Programme
  • Opportunity to travel to new locations to meet colleagues at 'sprints'
  • Priority Pass for travel and travel upgrades for long haul company events

About Canonical

Canonical is a pioneering tech firm that is at the forefront of the global move to open source. As the company that publishes Ubuntu, one of the most important open source projects and the platform for AI, IoT and the cloud, we are changing the world on a daily basis. We recruit on a global basis and set a very high standard for people joining the company. We expect excellence - in order to succeed, we need to be the best at what we do.

Canonical has been a remote‑first company since its inception in 2004. Work at Canonical is a step into the future, and will challenge you to think differently, work smarter, learn new skills, and raise your game. Canonical provides a unique window into the world of 21st‑century digital business.

Canonical is an equal opportunity employer

We are proud to foster a workplace free from discrimination. Diversity of experience, perspectives, and background create a better work environment and better products. Whatever your identity, we will give your application fair consideration.

The Talent Acquisition department hires qualified candidates to fill positions which contribute to the overall strategic success of Howard University. Join Howard University and thrive with us!

We are recruiting an Associate General Counsel for Faculty Affairs and Employment or a Senior Associate General Counsel, Faculty Affairs, Employment & Labor Relations. The selected incumbent provides in‑house legal counsel and strategic collaboration with Howard University and Howard University Hospital executives, academic administrators and the Office of Human Resources professionals regarding a comprehensive range of employment and labor relations matters. Advises and represents the University and Hospital on employment matters including but not limited to wrongful termination, discrimination, workers’ compensation and wage and hour claims brought by University and Hospital employees, including providing advice and counseling to University executives, academic administrators and Office of Human Resources professionals to ensure compliance with all applicable laws and regulations as well as advising on such matters in litigation.

Provides counsel and legal sufficiency review of legal documents, settlement agreements, discipline, suspensions, terminations, workplace policies, handbooks and other documents concerning employees. Supervises and manages outside counsel in employment and labor relations matters.

A candidate for the Senior Associate General Counsel will have substantial labor experience, in addition to a strong foundation in an employment‑related practice. The Senior Associate General Counsel will provide in‑house legal counsel services and represents Howard University as the supervisor of the primary in‑house labor attorney handling all matters involving the bargaining units of the University and Hospital and related collective bargaining agreements.

Supervisory Accountability

A candidate for the Associate General Counsel position will not have any direct supervisory accountability, but is expected to be primarily responsible for all employment and faculty related matters with a high level of autonomy. The Senior Associate General Counsel will supervise all employment‑related and labor‑related work of other staff attorneys. Serves as supervisor of other in‑house counsel who will be first chair on labor, collective bargaining and union matters.

Nature And Scope

Internal contacts include administrators, faculty, and staff of the University. External contacts include federal and local courts and administrative agencies including EEOC, OHR, DOL and OWH.

Principal Accountabilities

A candidate for the Associate General Counsel position will have primary responsibilities to provide in‑house legal advice, interpretation, and representation in a broad range of legal issues with employment related matters with knowledge of the labor process. In addition, a candidate for the Senior Associate General Counsel position will have supervisory responsibility for labor matters, including but not limited to representation in government agency investigations, grievances, arbitrations, and in cases before the National Labor Relations Board.

Responsibilities include reviewing and drafting workplace handbooks, policies and guidelines for legal sufficiency; providing review and recommendations regarding various regulatory and compliance matters. Other responsibilities include conducting formal training on EEO, wage & hour, mandated leave benefits, union representation, whistleblower, and other pertinent employment and labor law topics for new hires, current employees, and leadership. The incumbent also prepares legal documents such as offer letters, academic appointment contracts, settlement agreements, termination agreements, collective‑bargaining agreements, employment agreements. Also responsible for overseeing preparation of responses to information requests directed at Howard University or Hospital, advisory memoranda and documents relating to collective bargaining agreements, litigation matters or agency proceedings.

Represents the University in legal and quasi‑legal proceedings, including the District of Columbia and Federal courts and before government agencies on employment and labor relations matters and on other legal matters. Represents the University in hearings, meetings and in other forums related to University legal matters, as needed. Drafts and negotiates commitments involving University resources; principally contracts, settlements, other agreements and statements of University policy for subsequent approval by the General Counsel and University Officers. Reviews documents for other University offices for legal implications and possible legal policy questions. Responds to University officials’ request for advice in areas of assigned responsibility. Serves as office resource on updates and developments in employment and labor law.

Provides legal expertise and otherwise represents the office in meetings with University officials and individuals outside of the University. Provides counseling, advice, and guidance to academic administrators, supervisors and other management officials on faculty and staff conduct and performance problems. Provides assistance with conflict resolution, as requested. Furnishes recommendations to academic administrators, department heads, managers, and supervisors concerning possible courses of action in handling employee problems and concerns. Reviews employee discipline and discharge matters and makes recommendation for appropriate course of action. Reviews statistics and surveys and prepares analyses for review by the General Counsel. Reviews periodic utilization reports and develops appropriate management responses. Performs other job‑related duties as assigned.

Core Competencies

Detailed knowledge of federal and local laws applicable to employment and labor relations, and judicial and administrative agency systems and procedures. Ability to conduct and manage adversarial proceedings on behalf of the University and Hospital before courts and administrative agencies. Ability to plan, direct and conduct independent legal research and related analyses on a variety of labor and employment law topics. Ability to participate effectively in fact‑finding investigations, present findings and develop related recommendations. Ability to articulate the University’s position, listen and negotiate effectively. Superior verbal and written communication skills. Ability to draft, review, revise and edit documents in Word, Excel and PowerPoint. Ability to identify possible need for action and to plan, supervise, and execute appropriate assignments with minimal guidance or supervision. Ability to work productively under pressure, to adhere to and enforce deadlines, and to project need for and effectuate team efforts required to meet deadlines. Ability to follow guidance and direction and to provide effective guidance and direction. Ability to establish and maintain effective and harmonious work relations with faculty, staff, students, University officials, union representatives and the general public.

Minimum Requirements

A candidate for the Associate General Counsel position will have a Juris Doctor from an accredited law school and six years of post J.D. legal experience which includes at least four years of substantial employment experience, with additional knowledge of the labor process. A candidate for the Senior Associate General Counsel will have a Juris Doctor from an accredited law school and eight years of substantial labor and employment experience. All candidates must have a strong academic record; excellent oral and written communication skills. Membership or eligibility for membership in the District of Columbia Bar is required.

Compliance Salary Range Disclosure

Salary Range

The anticipated salary for the Associate General Counsel position is $172,800.

The anticipated salary for the Senior Associate General Counsel position is $207,800.

Com experiência em gestão de negócios desde 1955, aWLM atua de forma estratégica e integrada nos segmentos automotivo, do agronegócio, de energia e de soluções sustentáveis, consolidando-se como um grupo sólido, diversificado e em constante evolução.

O principal foco dos negócios da WLM é a comercialização de produtos e serviços da marca Scania, incluindo caminhões pesados e extrapesados, chassis para ônibus rodoviários e urbanos, venda de peças genuínas, além da prestação de serviços de manutenção corretiva e preventiva e assistência técnica especializada.

No segmento deconcessionárias Scania , a WLM está presente em mais de 20 pontos no país, atendendo seis estados brasileiros, por meio das operaçõesEquipo (RJ), Itaipu (MG), Itaipu Norte (PA), Quinta Roda (SP) eSupermac(AM e RR).

No segmento doagronegócio , por meio de suas controladasFartura (Sul do Pará) e Itapura (Norte do Mato Grosso, Sul de Minas e região de Campinas/SP) , a WLM atua nas atividades de cria, recria e engorda de bovinos, além da produção e comercialização de café, soja e milho. Com forte compromisso com a sustentabilidade, suas atividades produtivas são executadas com foco nas melhores práticas de preservação da fauna e flora nativas, bem como no cuidado com a água e o solo.

Em 2025, a WLM anunciou a aquisição de 60% daCHP Brasil , empresa referência em geração distribuída e eficiência energética. Com essa aquisição, o grupo amplia sua presença estratégica, diversifica seu portfólio e dá um passo significativo em direção ao futuro, reforçando seu compromisso com a sustentabilidade e com a criação de novas oportunidades de negócio no setor de energia.

A empresa expande o foco do grupo por meio da reciclagem de caminhões, da oferta de peças alternativas, componentes remanufaturados e contratos de manutenção, com forte uso de tecnologia. Seu foco principal está na redução do TCO (Custo Total de Propriedade) dos clientes, no fortalecimento da economia circular e na geração de eficiência operacional sustentável.

A localização estratégica das unidades da WLM permite uma atuação com ampla cobertura geográfica, garantindo agilidade, qualidade e excelência no atendimento.

A holding do grupo está localizada no Rio de Janeiro e conta com uma filial corporativa em Contagem/MG.

title: Sales Operations Specialist
description:
Who Are We?

Decentralized Masters is at the forefront of DeFi education globally. In just three years, we have grown from a pioneering pair of co‑founders to over 120 dedicated professionals. Today, we are recognized as one of the fastest‑growing enterprises in the sector, with industry insiders predicting our evolution into a unicorn company by 2030. Operating on a bootstrapped model, we are on track to achieve an impressive $50 million in revenue this year alone.

Our Impact

While our growth has been remarkable, we take even greater pride in the success of our clients. To date, we have empowered over 4,000 investors to break into the DeFi world. At Decentralized Masters, we don't just offer education; we cultivate a powerhouse of knowledge combined with an engaging community, innovative technology, and a team of leading DeFi and blockchain experts. Our commitment is to deliver unparalleled resources designed for long‑term success in the world of DeFi and Web3, ensuring our members not only safeguard but also enhance their financial future.

Our Vision

Our goal is to create the largest and most influential DeFi ecosystem the world has ever seen, starting with becoming the gold standard in DeFi education. This vision is ambitious, transformative, and poised to change the landscape of digital finance.

Are You Ready?

This is more than just a job; it's an opportunity to shape the future of Web3 technology and education. Are you ready to be part of our vision to redefine what's possible in DeFi and beyond? Apply below, and let's explore this journey together.

Check us out here: Decentralized Masters

What will you be doing?

The Sales Operations Specialist is responsible for ensuring the sales organization operates with speed, accuracy, visibility, and accountability. This role owns the day‑to‑day execution and optimization of the sales tech stack—primarily "HubSpot"—so that Membership Directors (MDs), Setters, and Sales Leadership can focus on selling, not admin. This is a hands‑on, systems‑focused role, not a people manager. You will work closely with Sales Leadership, Marketing, Fulfillment, and Data to maintain clean pipelines, automate workflows, enforce process discipline, and deliver reliable reporting. At Decentralized Masters, Sales Ops is mission‑critical. This role directly impacts close rates, cash collection, forecasting accuracy, and the overall scalability of the revenue engine.

Key Responsibilities

CRM Ownership & Sales Systems

  • Own accuracy of HubSpot CRM configuration: pipelines, deal stages, properties, workflows, and permissions
  • Ensure every lead, deal, and contact has correct lead status, lifecycle stages, ownership, and next steps
  • Maintain strict data hygiene standards (identifying/merging duplicates, no stale deals, missing properties, or broken workflows)
  • Enforce CRM usage standards across Setters and MDs

Sales Automation & Workflow Management

  • Build and maintain automation for:
    • Lead routing and assignment
    • Task creation and follow‑ups
    • Deal stage progression
    • Call outcomes and disposition tracking
  • Reduce manual admin work for sales reps wherever possible
  • QA all automations to ensure reliability and compliance

Pipeline, Forecasting & Reporting

  • Maintain accurate, real‑time visibility into:
    • Pipeline value and velocity
    • Close rates and conversion metrics
    • DPL (Deals Per Lead), APS, and other core KPIs
  • Build and maintain sales dashboards for leadership
  • Support forecasting and revenue reporting in collaboration with Finance and Data teams

Sales Tools & Integration

  • Manage and support integrations between HubSpot and:
    • Dialers (e.g., "Aloware")
    • Calendars and scheduling tools
    • Payment platforms (e.g., "Whop")
    • Analytics and BI tools
  • Troubleshoot system issues and coordinate fixes with internal tech or third‑party vendors

Process Enforcement & Enablement

  • Translate sales process changes into CRM logic and automation
  • Partner with Sales Leadership to ensure systems reinforce desired behaviors
  • Create and maintain SOPs for sales roles, systems and workflows
  • Act as the point person for Sales Ops requests, improvements, and bug fixes
  • Support and respond to Sales Ops requests submitted via Slack channels

Compliance & Data Integrity

  • Ensure CRM processes align with internal compliance standards (FTC/SEC‑aware language, DISCLAIMERS, documentation)
  • Maintain audit‑ready records for sales activity and deal history
  • Partner with Security/IT on access control and data governance

Requirements

What do you bring?

Required Experience

  • 2-5+ years in Sales Operations, RevOps, or CRM Administration
  • Hands‑on experience with "HubSpot" or similar CRM (required)
  • Mid‑Senior level Sales Operations experience
  • Strong background in sales automation and workflow design
  • Experience supporting high‑ticket or complex sales cycles preferred

Skills & Attributes

  • Highly systems‑oriented and detail‑driven
  • Strong understanding of sales metrics and funnels
  • Comfortable working cross‑functionally with Sales, Marketing, Fulfillment, and Data
  • Proactive problem‑solver who spots issues before they become revenue problems
  • Clear communicator who can translate business needs into system logic

Bonus (Nice to Have)

  • Experience in high‑growth, remote‑first environments
  • Familiarity with "Whop", "Aloware", or BI tools
  • Exposure to compliance‑heavy industries (finance, education, crypto, etc.)

Benefits

What We Offer

  • Competitive compensation
  • Remote‑first culture with a globally distributed team
  • Opportunity to own the organic growth engine of a fast‑scaling DeFi brand
  • Access to cutting‑edge tools, data, and creative freedom to innovate
  • A values‑driven company culture that rewards results, autonomy, and excellence

If you are ready to take on a challenge that will shape the future of crypto finance and grow with a team of innovators, we want to hear from you!

title: Montevideo Development Graduate Programme
description:
Based in Montevideo, the two-year Development Graduate Programme offers, 3 × 8 month rotations, across Deals Desk, Operations and Trade Finance in Energy or Metals and Minerals.

Throughout the programme, graduates gain practical experience and exposure to the full trade lifecycle, working at the core of our operations. By building expertise across these critical functions, graduates develop a strong foundation for success in high-impact middle office roles in Deals Desk, Operations and Trade Finance and are well‑positioned to grow into future leadership positions.

Guided by some of the most experienced professionals in the industry, graduates receive ongoing support and development opportunities, providing them with the skills, mindset and confidence to help shape the next chapter of our business.

Deals Desk

Deals Desk is responsible for accurate mark‑to‑market valuation, daily P&L and risk and exposure reporting. Deals Desk is an independent control function that works closely with commercial, middle and back‑office teams to ensure timely trade capture and effective management of trading positions in our trading and risk management systems.

Responsibilities include
  • Reviewing and verifying trades and trade terms
  • Producing daily P&L and exposure reports
  • Liaising with traders, operations and finance to reconcile positions
  • Investigating and resolving trade discrepancies

Operations

Operations coordinates the physical movement and delivery of commodities, ensuring contracts are executed efficiently and profitably.

Responsibilities include
  • Managing vessel or land logistics and documentation
  • Liaising with counter parties and terminal
  • Tracking cargo movements and inventories
  • Ensuring compliance with contractual and regulatory requirements

Trade Finance

Trade Finance designs and implements the financing solutions that enable the physical movement of commodities, while managing credit and performance risks.

Responsibilities include
  • Structuring and executing real‑world commodity trade finance deals
  • Drafting, negotiating and managing trade documents such as letters of credit, guarantees and receivables financing
  • Monitoring global trade flows, payment schedules and risk exposure across complex transactions
  • Collaborating with traders, operations, credit teams and banking partners to resolve day‑to‑day financing and logistics challenges

Knowledge Skills And Abilities

  • 0-2 years of postgraduate working experience
  • Fluency in English and Spanish - both oral and written
  • Strong verbal and written communication skills
  • High degree of intellectual curiosity, passion, motivation and grit
  • Ability to remove roadblocks and break down barriers to get the job done
  • Passion for working in a collaborative, challenging and dynamic environment
  • A global, innovative mindset

description:
This position requires full relocation to Saudi Arabia. It is a permanent full time Expat Relocation Package.

Job Overview

We are seeking a Safety Advisor to join the Saudi Aramco Loss Prevention organization (LP).

LP is responsible for providing both day-to-day in-field occupational and process safety support to Saudi Aramco operations, as well as centralized technical support and consulting function. Our field offices are located in Abqaiq, Riyadh, Ras Tanura, Dhahran, Udhailiyah, Jeddah (including Yanbu and Jazan), and Tanajib. Through these offices, LP provides its services to all Saudi Aramco facilities and departments that are located throughout the Kingdom.

Your primary role is to provide daily support to company facilities and departments, helping them effectively implement the Saudi Aramco Safety Management System expectations and associated programs, as well as assuring compliance to all company safety requirements.

Key Responsibilities

As the successful candidate you will be required to perform the following:

  • Facilitate implementation of the Saudi Aramco Safety Management System, as well as its objectives and expectations, including developing associated safety processes, and participating in self-assessments.
  • Conduct field inspections/reviews to assess compliance to company and international codes and standards, identify safety concerns, formulate solutions, and develop practical and cost-effective corrective actions.
  • Identify, evaluate, recommend actions, and follow up on critical, yet universal safety tasks and control methodologies related to operational safety practices (e.g., work at height, isolation/LOTO, permit to work, hydrogen sulfide, confined space entry, excavations).
  • Participate in safety studies/activities using risk assessment and mitigation methodologies, such as: PHAs, HAZOPs, JSAs, incident investigations, compliance reviews, or insurance surveys.
  • Respond to emergency situations and incidents, either during or after regular working hours, to provide technical assistance and advice.
  • Participate in worksite contractor safety management activities (e.g., contractor selection and prequalification, monitoring of work site compliance, and measurement of performance).
  • Support the reporting, classification and investigation all incidents, and participating in incident investigations, determination of root causes, and proper recommendations to prevent recurrence.
  • Deliver Loss Prevention-specific training to employees, contractors, and outside parties.
  • Mentor other LP personnel.
  • You will hold a Bachelor of Science degree from an Accredited Institution and seven years of experience areas in the oil and gas, petrochemicals, or related industries, such as: operations and maintenance, plant engineering, construction, turnaround and inspection, safety program development, process safety, and audits/assessments.
  • Or you will have 15 years of relevant industry experience in the oil and gas, petrochemicals, or related industries, including a strong track record in delivering results, as referenced above, without a degree.
  • You will also have an excellent ability to communicate in English with peers as well as members of management, and be able to produce clear and concise oral and written reports in English.

Our high-performing employees are drawn by the challenging and rewarding professional, technical and industrial opportunities we offer, and are remunerated accordingly.

description:
Descrição da vaga

Somos a PRIO, a maior companhia independente de óleo e gás do Brasil. Buscamos continuamente por otimização de processos operacionais e de soluções inovadoras que visem diminuir os custos. Aqui todo trabalho é multidisciplinar e cada desafio é único!

Responsabilidades e atribuições

  • Atração & Seleção: Entender as demandas das áreas clientes, apoiando gestores na definição de cargos, perfis e requisitos das vagas; acompanhar processos de recrutamento e seleção, garantindo alinhamento com as necessidades do negócio e SLAs acordados.
  • Treinamento & Desenvolvimento: Acompanhar e apoiar a execução de treinamentos obrigatórios e ações de desenvolvimento nas áreas clientes; apoiar gestores e colaboradores na definição de planos de desenvolvimento individual (PDIs), utilizando sistemas de gestão e ferramentas de RH; acompanhar a implementação de programas e ações de desenvolvimento, garantindo alinhamento às prioridades do negócio e eficiência operacional.
  • Performance, Carreira e Sucessão: Executar e suportar os ciclos de avaliação de desempenho, por meio de reuniões com gestores e colaboradores, fóruns de equalização e reconhecimento, assegurando direcionamento claro para evolução e meritocracia; apoiar movimentações internas e decisões de carreira; participar do mapeamento de posições críticas e sucessores, por meio de reuniões e atualizações em sistemas, garantindo continuidade dos negócios e desenvolvimento de talentos; fornecer suporte consultivo aos gestores, fortalecendo seu papel como protagonistas na gestão de pessoas.
  • Cultura, Engajamento e Clima Organizacional: Atuar como guardião da cultura organizacional, apoiando a construção e disseminação de rotinas e práticas alinhadas aos valores da empresa; conduzir e apoiar pesquisas de clima e engajamento, desde a comunicação e sensibilização até a análise dos resultados e desdobramento de planos de ação junto às lideranças; levantar oportunidades de melhoria nos canais de atendimento aos colaboradores, com base em interações e feedbacks, propondo ajustes que aprimorem a comunicação, a experiência do colaborador e o engajamento das equipes; garantir a atualização dos dados de colaboradores nos sistemas de RH.
  • Orçamento de Pessoas e Governança: Acompanhar a elaboração, controle e revisões do orçamento anual de pessoas das áreas clientes, incluindo headcount, movimentações salariais, meritocracia e provisões, por meio de análises, relatórios e alinhamentos com lideranças e áreas parceiras, assegurando aderência às diretrizes financeiras, políticas internas e estratégias do negócio.
  • Desligamento: Apoiar gestores nos processos de desligamento, garantindo alinhamento com políticas e boas práticas de RH; conduzir entrevistas de desligamento, analisando dados e gerando insights para identificação de oportunidades de melhoria e definição de planos de ação quando necessário.

Requisitos e qualificações

  • Formação superior completa em Administração, Psicologia ou áreas correlatas.
  • Experiência prévia como Business Partner.
  • Conhecimento intermediário em sistemas de RH (como SuccessFactors), Excel avançado e ferramentas básicas de análise de dados.
  • Inglês Avançado.

Informações adicionais

Como é o processo seletivo na PRIO?

Gostamos de já chegar na entrevista te conhecendo um pouco, então pedimos a você que preencha ainda na etapa de cadastro alguns testes para podermos avaliar o seu Match com a nossa Cultura :)

Depois, nós do time de RH vamos marcar um papo com você. A ideia aqui é aprofundar um pouco mais nas suas experiências, buscando o alinhamento com o perfil da vaga e comportamental que buscamos para a PRIO. Ah, nesse papo também vamos falar sobre a companhia, fluxo do processo, benefícios e tirar suas dúvidas!

Dica: Nesse nosso papo, vamos querer saber sobre experiências que você já vivenciou, alinhadas aos valores da PRIO. A ideia é que você consiga nos apresentar essas vivências de forma completa, com contextos, sua responsabilidade, o que você fez e qual foi o resultado!

Em seguida, vamos adentrando em aspectos mais técnicos, que podem envolver um case ou apenas uma entrevista com o(a) gestor(a) da vaga, aonde você poderá conhecer um pouco mais sobre os desafios técnicos da vaga e será avaliado dentro dos requisitos da vaga.

Ao fim, os finalistas conversam com o diretor da respectiva área para a escolha final!

Como se preparar para o processo seletivo na PRIO:

  • Pesquise sobre o negócio da companhia e nossa atuação no setor de óleo e gás;
  • Busque se atualizar sobre as notícias recentes da companhia, sejam da imprensa ou divulgadas em nosso site de relações com investidores;
  • Acesses nossas redes sociais para conhecer mais sobre como é trabalhar na PRIO!
  • Pense na sua história e principais realizações. Estruture seus resultados e conquistas para relatá-los na hora da entrevista.

Fale dos sucessos, mas entender as falhas e como você aprendeu com elas também é importante. Prezamos pela transparência, por isso, não tenha medo de falar sobre os seus insucessos.

Desejamos a você um bom processo seletivo!

description:
Descrição da vaga

Somos a PRIO, a maior companhia independente de óleo e gás do Brasil. Buscamos continuamente por otimização de processos operacionais e de soluções inovadoras que visem diminuir os custos. Aqui todo trabalho é multidisciplinar e cada desafio é único!

Estamos em busca de um Analista de Folha de Pagamento Sênior para atuar nas rotinas de processamento da folha e administração de pessoal, assegurando a acurácia e a conformidade dos cálculos e pagamentos, além de contribuir para melhorias contínuas, confiabilidade das operações e cumprimento dos prazos legais.

Responsabilidades e atribuições

  • Executar todo o processo de folha de pagamento, inputs, apuração e lançamentos necessários para o processamento da folha, garantindo a conformidade com a legislação trabalhista, previdenciária e fiscal.
  • Calcular, via sistema, salários, encargos sociais e impostos incidentes sobre a folha de pagamento, assegurando o cumprimento dos prazos legais de pagamento e recolhimento.
  • Apurar encargos trabalhistas, bem como executar o processo de contabilização, provisão e conciliação da folha de pagamento em conjunto com a área contábil.
  • Apoiar os processos de administração de pessoal, incluindo conferência e importação do ponto para a folha, cálculo e pagamento de férias e rescisões, assegurando conformidade legal e cumprimento de prazos.
  • Apoiar a implantação e estabilização de novos sistemas de folha de pagamento, atuando no mapeamento de processos, testes, validação de dados, homologação de cálculos e suporte à transição, garantindo a continuidade e a acuracidade das rotinas de folha.
  • Acompanhar e dar suporte a colaboradores em processos de transferência internacional, assegurando o correto tratamento da folha, encargos e compliance local e internacional.

Requisitos e qualificações

  • Formação superior completa em Administração, Ciências Contábeis, Economia ou áreas correlatas.
  • Conhecimento sólido de sistemas de folha de pagamento e ponto eletrônico, com habilidade para realizar cálculos complexos e validar integrações entre sistemas.
  • Domínio da legislação trabalhista e previdenciária, com capacidade para interpretar convenções coletivas e aplicar regras em cenários diversos.
  • Familiaridade com obrigações acessórias e ferramentas de controle fiscal, como eSocial.
  • Experiência prévia em sistemas integrados de RH e implementação de sistemas é um diferencial.

Informações adicionais

Como é o processo seletivo na PRIO?

Gostamos de já chegar na entrevista te conhecendo um pouco, então pedimos a você que preencha ainda na etapa de cadastro alguns testes para podermos avaliar o seu Match com a nossa Cultura :)

Depois, nós do time de RH vamos marcar um papo com você. A ideia aqui é aprofundar um pouco mais nas suas experiências, buscando o alinhamento com o perfil da vaga e comportamental que buscamos para a PRIO. Ah, nesse papo também vamos falar sobre a companhia, fluxo do processo, benefícios e tirar suas dúvidas!

Dica: Nesse nosso papo, vamos querer saber sobre experiências que você já vivenciou, alinhadas aos valores da PRIO. A ideia é que você consiga nos apresentar essas vivências de forma completa, com contextos, sua responsabilidade, o que você fez e qual foi o resultado!

Em seguida, vamos adentrando em aspectos mais técnicos, que podem envolver um case ou apenas uma entrevista com o(a) gestor(a) da vaga, aonde você poderá conhecer um pouco mais sobre os desafios técnicos da vaga e será avaliado dentro dos requisitos da vaga.

Ao fim, os finalistas conversam com o diretor da respectiva área para a escolha final!

Como se preparar para o processo seletivo na PRIO:

  • Pesquise sobre o negócio da companhia e nossa atuação no setor de óleo e gás;
  • Busque se atualizar sobre as notícias recentes da companhia, sejam da imprensa ou divulgadas em nosso site de relações com investidores;
  • Acesse nossas redes sociais para conhecer mais sobre como é trabalhar na PRIO!
  • Pense na sua história e principais realizações. Estruture seus resultados e conquistas para relatá-los na hora da entrevista.
  • Fale dos sucessos, mas entender as falhas e como você aprendeu com elas também é importante. Prezamos pela transparência, por isso, não tenha medo de falar sobre os seus insucessos.

Desejamos a você um bom processo seletivo!

description:
Job ID: | Amazon Logistica do Brasil

Você quer trabalhar duro, se divertir e fazer história? Se sim, a Amazon pode ser a escolha de carreira certa para você. Nossas equipes de logística estão mudando a maneira como interagimos com clientes em todo o mundo todos os dias e resolvendo alguns dos maiores desafios logísticos enfrentados não apenas pela Amazon, mas também por toda a indústria.

As equipes de transporte da Amazon trabalham para garantir a entrega de pacotes para clientes em todo o mundo. Sejam itens grandes ou pequenos, encontramos soluções para garantir que estamos cumprindo nossa promessa para os clientes.

A equipe da Amazon Logística está em busca de um(a) Líder de Time para se juntar à equipe da AMZL Brasil em para a nossa Delivery Station no Rio de Janeiro, RJ.

Como líder de equipe, você supervisionará uma de nossas estações de entrega, fornecendo liderança aos associados e gerenciando o desempenho dos principais indicadores – Key Performance Indicators (KPIs). Você assumirá muitas funções e trabalhará em um ambiente altamente colaborativo que é mais próximo de uma start-up do que uma grande empresa. A atitude adotada é que nenhuma ideia é uma má ideia e as melhores ideias são aquelas que devem ser testadas e experimentadas. Você precisará prosperar e entregar resultados em um ambiente ambíguo, rápido e dinâmico. A função envolve:

  • Estar presencialmente na estação de entrega. Amazon lidera operações 24-7, e portanto, trabalhar em diferentes turnos será parte dessa função, incluindo finais de semana e feriados.
  • Criar e cultivar um ambiente de trabalho seguro, identificando oportunidades de segurança em sua área de trabalho.
  • Liderar e treinar os associados para entregar o melhor serviço aos nossos clientes.
  • Garantir que os pedidos dos clientes sejam atendidos de acordo com as diretrizes de segurança e qualidade.
  • Fornecimento contínuo de informações críticas relacionadas ao turno aos operadores.
  • Envolver-se com funções de suporte e/ou outros departamentos para abordar problemas ou necessidades comuns de indicadores de desempenho, por exemplo, processos de readiness, 5S, segurança, treinamento.
  • Monitoramento do andamento das rotas, atuando de forma proativa para identificar e corrigir desvios e adequar, com foco na superação da expectativa do cliente e no gerenciamento dos custos de operação.
  • Condução de reuniões, atribuição de funções e - Trabalhar com KPIs como despacho pontual, sucesso na entrega no primeiro dia (On Time Dispatch, First Day Delivery Success) e aprimoramento do atendimento ao cliente.
  • Ficar obcecado por métricas e mergulhar fundo para encontrar as causas raízes rapidamente para impulsionar as melhorias.
  • Encontrar soluções práticas e simples para problemas complexos sem sacrificar a qualidade ou a funcionalidade principal.
  • Fornecer suporte diário durante o lançamento / implementação de sistemas / processos mais novos e coletar feedback.
  • Utilizar continuamente ferramentas de software e hardware para garantir as operações normais do dia a dia. Garantir que os associados tenham ferramentas adequadas para realizar o trabalho e coordenar o reparo ou substituição quando necessário.
  • Comunicar as métricas diárias e relatar exceções a outros departamentos em Operações e em toda a Amazon, conforme necessário.

Key job responsibilities

Nossa cultura inclusiva capacita os Amazonians a oferecer os melhores resultados para nossos clientes. Não celebramos apenas a diversidade de nossa força de trabalho, celebramos as diversas formas como trabalhamos. Se você quiser solicitar uma acomodação para a entrevista ou o processo de integração, avise seu recrutador e ele o conectará à nossa equipe de acomodação

description:
Overview

FIFA has established a Local FIFA Subsidiary in Brazil to work together with FIFA Zurich to deliver the biggest women’s sporting event in the world, the FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027™ (“FWWC2027”) that for the first time ever, is hosted in South America in Brazil. Now is your time to be part of the workforce that is creating this unique and unforgettable experience.

Department: Events & Entertainment

Location: Brazil

Please submit your CV in English, as it will be reviewed by an international team.

THE POSITION

Reporting to the Senior Volunteer Manager – FIFA27, the Volunteer System Manager will play a key role in shaping and managing the volunteer journey through the FIFA Volunteer Platform, supporting operations across eight Host Cities within the Integrated Model.

The purpose of this role is to lead the set-up, operation, and maintenance of the FIFA Volunteer Platform, which serves as the foundation for the entire volunteer experience. The successful candidate will also oversee essential system integrations to ensure a seamless, efficient, and high-quality operational process for the tournament. This role will work in close collaboration with the Volunteer Management Teams at FIFA Zurich, FIFA27, Host Cities in Brazil and the FIFA Volunteer Platform provider, as well as with other Functional Areas, to ensure the technology platforms meet all operational requirements while supporting the successful delivery of the Volunteer Programme.

We are seeking an innovative and experienced systems professional with a proven record in managing complex, large-scale event operations. The ideal candidate will join a dynamic, multicultural environment and bring both strategic insight and firsthand expertise to one of the most exciting sporting events in the world.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Work on development of all system processes in the FIFA volunteer platform, from application through to tournament-time management, including test events and satellite events
  • Participate in the planning phase to finalise configuration of the FIFA Volunteer Platform ensuring it fully supports the requirements of the Integrated Model for a consistent volunteer experience and operational processes across all Host Cities.
  • Support the review and refine system functionalities to meet the evolving needs of the FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027™.
  • Ensure operational readiness to test and finalise the application form for the Volunteer Programme launch.
  • Ensure integration with other FIFA and local systems, managing all dependencies.
  • Act as the volunteer department’s main point of contact for User Access, User Validation, UAT (User Acceptance Testing), and system simulations.
  • Identify and propose technical solutions to operational challenges not addressed by existing functionality.
  • Ensure data integrity, compliance, and security across all volunteer systems in-line with FIFA’s data protection standards.
  • Act as the first point of escalation and resolution for volunteer system issues.
  • Promote best practices in data management, analytics, and system governance.
  • Lead the creation of data reports, dashboards, and analytical tools for operational insights and decision-making.
  • Monitor and report on project timelines, change requests, and system risks in line with the integrated volunteer systems plan.
  • Establish clear reporting and monitoring processes to evaluate programme effectiveness, volunteer satisfaction, and service delivery.
  • Lead the preparation and delivery of training materials and conduct “Train-the-Trainer” sessions for system users.
  • Ensure compliance to the FIFA tournament guidelines and oversee project execution in alignment with the approved budget, identifying efficiencies and cost-effective delivery methods.
  • Contribute to the development and implementation of an International Volunteer Welcome Strategy, including logistics, visa facilitation, and cultural integration.
  • Ensure a structured systems close-out process, including comprehensive handover and debrief report.
  • Represent the Volunteer team in cross-functional area meetings, host city briefings, readiness workshops, stakeholder engagements, and strategic planning.

YOUR PROFILE

  • Minimum 5 years of experience in large-scale volunteer, workforce, or sport event programme management.
  • Education: Master’s in Sports Management or Event Management or Technology, Information Systems, or Project Management preferred.
  • Proven experience managing large-scale technology or systems implementation projects.
  • Excellent organizational, communication, and project management skills.
  • Strong analytical and reporting skills, including proficiency with data visualisation and business intelligence tools.
  • High cultural awareness with experience in multi-stakeholder and multicultural environments.
  • Training delivery experience a plus
  • Familiarity with volunteer management systems (Rosterfy) and related IT tools is highly desirable.
  • Ability to be flexible and adopt an innovative mindset
  • Team player with internal and external stakeholders
  • Ability to thrive in an international, dynamic, and fast-paced environment.
  • Collaborative and empathetic team player, passionate about community-building, sport, and service.
  • Creativity and resourcefulness to enhance the volunteer experience and drive engagement.
  • Anticipates needs, understands the strategic impact of systems, and drives continuous improvement.

-Pesquise sobre o negócio da companhia e nossa atuação no setor de óleo e gás;

-Busque se atualizar sobre as notícias recentes da companhia, sejam da imprensa ou divulgadas em nosso site de relações com investidores;

-Acesses nossas redes sociais para conhecer mais sobre como é trabalhar na PRIO!

-Pense na sua história e principais realizações. Estruture seus resultados e conquistas para relatá-los na hora da entrevista.

Fale dos sucessos, mas entender as falhas e como você aprendeu com elas também é importante. Prezamos pela transparência, por isso, não tenha medo de falar sobre os seus insucessos.

Desejamos a você um bom processo seletivo!

We are the independent expert in assurance and risk management. Driven by our purpose, to safeguard life, property, and the environment, we empower our customers and their stakeholders with facts and reliable insights so that critical decisions can be made with confidence.

Risk Management unit Brazil is seeking a talented Computational Fluid Dynamics (CFD)/ Process Safety Senior/Principal Consultant with a proven ability to tackle complex technical challenges, to join a fast-paced technical safety consultancy at the cutting edge of risk analysis techniques. This is a great opportunity to be part of a motivated team that is a trusted voice to tackle global transformations and challenges, helping our customers in achieving the safety of their assets and operations.

The Risk Management South America team provide a wide range of advisory safety engineering and risk management services to the energy industry, for CAPEX and OPEX projects, in Brazil and worldwide. The Senior/Principal Consultant is expected to liaise with and support several customers and stakeholders including regulatory agencies mainly in the upstream segments, but also in midstream and downstream segments, and tackle energy transition topics, such as BESS, CCS and Hydrogen.

The Senior/Principal Consultant reports to a Team Leader and has responsibility for technical delivery of projects with collaboration of other team members and has technical leadership of more junior consultants besides project management. The role includes customer interaction to find solutions to their challenges and discuss project schedule/delivery, technical issues and solutions. The Senior/Principal consultant will have opportunity to interact with customers and other offices globally.

  • Graduated in Engineering (Chemical or Mechanical desirable), for at least 6 years (mandatory)

  • Spanish will be considered a plus.

Somos ICONIC, uma empresa líder de mercado que nasceu da fusão dos negócios de lubrificantes da Ipiranga e da Chevron no Brasil.

Um time de mais de 1000 colaboradores, altamente especializados e dinâmicos. Somos responsáveis pelo desenvolvimento, produção, distribuição e comercialização de lubrificantes, fluídos, graxas e coolants... mas nosso propósito vai muito além!

Por meio do nosso Centro de Tecnologia ICONIC, um dos maiores e mais avançados laboratórios da América Latina e nossas conexões globais, desenvolvemos um portfólio completo com mais de 1.000 produtos. Inovação e tecnologia para prover soluções para os desafios dos mais diversos segmentos: automotivo, industrial, naval, agrícola, geração de energia. Nossas 2 fábricas, com capacidade produtiva superior a 500 milhões de litros por ano, nossa ampla capacidade logística em todo país, somado a um terminal de óleos básicos e uma rede de Distribuidores, atendem mais de 100 mil clientes com nossas grandes marcas, reconhecidas pela sua excelência e qualidade: Texaco Lubrificantes e Ipiranga Lubrificantes.

Descrição e resumo do cargo:

A área de Produtos da ICONIC é responsável por garantir um portfólio técnico robusto, competitivo e alinhado às demandas do mercado brasileiro de lubrificantes — um setor altamente tecnológico, com constante evolução em motores, máquinas e requisitos regulatórios. Aqui, conectamos inovação e estratégia!

Nosso propósito é desenvolver produtos que entreguem performance, valor e confiabilidade, sustentando o crescimento da companhia e a liderança nos segmentos onde atuamos.

Principais atividades:

  • Gerenciar linhas de produtos, identificando necessidades tecnológicas, aprovações, movimentações da concorrência e tendências de mercado, garantindo um portfólio completo e competitivo para a ICONIC

  • Preparar e ministrar treinamentos (presenciais e EAD) para equipes internas, clientes e parceiros, disseminando conhecimento sobre aplicações, benefícios e performance dos produtos.
  • Desenvolver conteúdos técnicos para materiais de Marketing e vendas, assegurando coerência técnica em rótulos, embalagens e documentos oficiais da companhia.
  • Participar de processos de homologação junto aos fabricantes de equipamentos (OEMs), elaborando e apresentando documentos técnicos que garantam robustez e diferenciação competitiva aos produtos ICONIC.
  • Acompanhar o ciclo de vida dos produtos, propondo lançamentos, melhorias e descontinuidades com foco em estratégia, custo‑benefício e evolução tecnológica.
  • Engenharia Química, Engenharia Mecânica, Química, Petroquímica ou áreas correlatas.

SOBRE NÓS

Fundado por portugueses nos anos 50 com o nome “Casas Guanabara”, o pequeno comércio se transformou no Supermercados Guanabara, uma das mais tradicionais e modernas redes do país. Atualmente possui 28 lojas distribuídas no Rio, Grande Rio, Baixada Fluminense e Região Metropolitana, dois centros de distribuição e dois depósitos.

Para garantir a melhor experiência de compras para os seus clientes, prezando pelo conforto e segurança, as unidades contam com piso antiderrapante, rampas de acesso para facilitar a circulação, corredores amplos, grande quantidade de check‑outs, estacionamento inteligente, além de um mix diferenciado para atender a qualquer orçamento.

E não para por aí! A rede de Supermercados Guanabara seguindo a tendência mundial do setor supermercadista implantou nas lojas a captação da água da chuva e do sistema de ar‑condicionado, com reúso nos banheiros e lavagem das lojas. A iluminação tem a tecnologia LED e um projeto arquitetônico que inclui fachada de vidro para evitar o desperdício de energia.

Você sabia que a rede inovou e levou o shopping para dentro do supermercado? Atualmente várias unidades Guanabara possui centro comercial com lojas de serviço e grandes magazines. Algumas lojas operam com sistema store in store, orientação de sommelier na hora da escolha de vinhos.

O Guanabara também inovou no calendário varejista do estado do Rio de Janeiro e criou campanhas promocionais como: Semana da Beleza, Semana da Limpeza, Guanababy, Black Fraldas e o tradicional Aniversário Guanabara!

A rede já foi eleita pela revista Veja Rio como "A marca mais amada do Rio" e por 15 anos pela pesquisa “Marcas dos Cariocas”, em parceria com O Globo, a "Marca preferida dos Cariocas" .

E você sabe qual o segredo de todo esse sucesso? São os 14 mil talentos que compõem esse time campeão.

Além de sonhar, se desenvolver, construir e crescer dentro de um ambiente meritocrático e inclusivo e ser capaz de fazer a diferença unindo as pessoas por um mundo melhor!

Seja bem-vindo à Ambev.

ENTRE PARA UM TIME QUE SONHA TÃO GRANDE COMO VOCÊ!

Somos milhares de apaixonados e apaixonadas pelo que fazemos. Temos um orgulho imenso do nosso poder de impacto positivo e reconhecemos que, agindo como donos e donas, cada um de nós desempenha um papel fundamental no sucesso do nosso ecossistema. Somado a isso, todas nossas grandes conquistas tem o sabor da colaboração! Nosso sucesso é compartilhado e acreditamos que por meio da colaboração podemos encantar ainda mais os nossos clientes com as marcas que eles amam hoje, ao mesmo tempo em que podemos atender aos gostos de amanhã.

title: Psicólogo escolar
description:
Responsibilities

  • Use appropriate techniques to meet the developmental, preventative and remedial needs of pupils
  • Ensure that the Educational PsychologyService role is understood by pupils, staff and parents by developing a policy to be put into the staff manual.
  • Share appropriate information about pupils with school personnel and parents when deemed necessary and respecting the Brazilian Psychologist Code of Ethics and Conduct
  • Support teachers and coordinators to plan for Personal, Social and Health Education (PSHE)
  • Liaise with Educational Psychology Service at other sites, in order to maintain the same quality of service throughout the whole school.
  • Demonstrate a knowledge of Psychology theories and select appropriate models and techniques for individual and group support.
  • Assist Learning Support Department (LS), when requested, to identify and address disabilities which affect the student´s learning in any area.
  • Continuously seek input from various groups (pupils, teachers, parents) in making decisions about the Educational Psychology Service
  • Work with pupils: whom are experiencing issues with bereavement, parental separation, socialization, eating disorders, alcohol/drug abuse, depression, bullying, physical or sexual abuse A caring community, striving for excellence,where every individual matters. aggression and those pupils on the Learning Support Register when deemed necessary
  • Work with parents, teachers and other school community personnel to support the pupil profile and pastoral systems
  • Support the PSHE programme in the Senior School by undertaking group dynamics with students on related topics
  • Contribute to annual strategic plans, focusing on pastoral and PSHE development.
  • Liaise with outside agencies within the Health field (Psychologists, Psychiatrists, Neurologists, Speech Therapists, Occupational Therapists and Physiotherapists)
  • Adhere to the ethical standards of the school and at the same time respecting the confidentiality of all matters pertaining to the Educational Psychology Service, according to the Brazilian Psychologist Code of Ethics and Conduct.
  • Initiate and coordinate school-wide activities, in conjunction with Heads of Section/Head of Pastoral.
  • Present instructional/informational and prevention programmes to groups of pupils, teachers, community personnel and parents (e.g. Parental Informative workshops, staff INSETs)
  • Work together with the staff development team offering behavior management meetings to staff
  • Manage time effectively to provide services on schedule while maintaining an organized, functional, and up-to-date office.
  • Communicate effectively with pupils, parents, staff and other school community personnel
  • Develop a referral system to be used by teachers for the Educational Psychology Service
  • Keep records of requests for intervention, observations and actions taken by the Educational Psychology Service
  • Use technology efficiently to maintain records and to share these with managers when deemed necessary, as well as respecting the Brazilian Psychologist Code of Ethics and Conduct
  • Managing the Educational Psychology Service budget.

Requirements

  • A Bachelor degree in Psychology.
  • A degree in Special Education and Psychopedagogy is desirable.
  • Professional Registration with CRP (Conselho Regional de Psicologia).
  • Special Education experience is also desirable.

Safeguarding

All staff at TBSRJ must take seriously the responsibility to safeguard and promote the welfare of children,

and to work together with others to ensure adequate arrangements within the school help to identify,

assess, and support children who are suffering harm.

How to apply

Interested candidates should apply through the TES platform, where you will be prompted to submit the following confidential materials by 09 March 2026:

  • Cover letter expressing interest and qualifications for this position
  • Three referees, including one from your current post

description:
The Talent Acquisition department hires qualified candidates to fill positions which contribute to the overall strategic success of Howard University. Here Is What We Offer

  • Health & Wellness: Comprehensive medical, dental, and vision insurance, plus mental health support
  • Work‑Life Balance: PTO, paid holidays, flexible work arrangements
  • Financial Wellness: Competitive salary, 403(b) with company match
  • Professional Development: Ongoing training, tuition reimbursement, and career advancement paths
  • Additional Perks: Wellness programs, commuter benefits, and a vibrant company culture

Join Howard University and thrive with us!

Job Purpose

The purpose of this position is to provide primary coordination and facilitation of training and education programs affiliated with the MidAtlantic AIDS Education and Training Center Howard University Regional Partner, and the College of Pharmacy. Assures compliance with the scope of work, HRSA guidance, and serves as a Training Coordinator for all activities planned by the project, including needs assessment, data collection, and programming for all projects, including: Core, Minority AIDS Initiative, CDC, Inter‑Professional Education, Practice Transformation, Ending the HIV Epidemic and COVID-19.

Supervisory Authority

Involves no responsibility or authority for the direction of others.

Nature And Scope

Internal contacts include executives, administrators and employees from all divisions and departments within the university structure. External contacts include auditors, representatives from federal, state and local regulatory agencies and vendors.

Principal Accountabilities

  • Monitor evaluate and record training activities and program effectiveness. Setup and coordinate HIV‑related topic training programs to help DC Metropolitan healthcare professionals maintain or improve job skills. Assess training needs through surveys, interviews with employees, focus groups, or consultation with managers, instructors or customer representatives.
  • Develop alternative training methods if expected improvements are not seen. Organize and develop, or obtain, training procedure manuals and guides and course materials such as handouts and visual materials.
  • Organizing and facilitating monthly video conference calls, in person meetings, training events
  • Present information, using a variety of instructional techniques and formats such as role playing, simulations, team exercises, group discussions, videos and lectures.
  • Evaluate training materials prepared by trainers/subject matter experts such as outlines, text, and handouts.
  • Design, plan, organize and direct orientation and training for employees or customers of industrial or commercial establishment. Monitor training costs to ensure budget is not exceeded and prepare budget reports to justify expenditures. Select and assign instructors to conduct training.
  • Works with subcontractors to ensure the programs are developed that identify training needs, and effectively reach targeted audience and enhance the quality of education. Manages the certification process for continuing education credits for the designated professions.
  • Increases the center’s participation in collaborative efforts among varied professional organizations, pharmaceuticals, community‑based organization, professional schools and state and local government agencies.
  • Participates in all conferences and communications to subcontracts.
  • Supports the efforts of the department in organizing, maintaining and appropriate documentation to the Department Chair and Associate Dean of the school or department.
  • Maintaining files for the various MidAtlantic AIDS Education and Training Center projects and helping organize all required documentation to and from our funders and regional partner sites.
  • Meets Program Quarterly goals and creates reports for internal staff regarding programmatic activities.
  • Create training schedules for all programs, track and create reports on outcomes of all training and maintain training records for the department.
  • Attend seminars and meetings to learn new training methods and techniques and use the knowledge to prepare and coordinate future training sessions.
  • Recruit new speakers.
  • Prepare and submit speaker contracts to the Regional Coordinator.
  • Establish and maintain strong relationships with community‑based agencies, local, and state government.
  • Prepare and submit monthly reports on projects outcome and related activities.
  • Enter all technical assistance and activities in the database.
  • Provide customized coaching at the clinical site (e.g., CIDMAR) by working with the site to identify site‑specific needs and opportunities, prioritizing areas of focus, and identifying available and needed resources.
  • Address barriers to effective implementation of improvement processes; propose solutions for practices/health centers to consider in addressing barriers.
  • Advise individual clinical sites on the implementation of the interventions and measures, sharing specific best practice examples.
  • Serve as an active member of a practice transformation learning collaborative group.
  • Interact and collaborate with other practice coaches and planning groups. Receive training on practice coaching and the interventions and tools for site implementation.
  • Ensure implementation fidelity. Transparently share challenges and barriers regarding site implementation and share solutions for effectively implementing the interventions.
  • Work within the learning collaborative group to further refine the interventions, measures, and associated tools. Research and develop innovative ideas for future spread of best practices.
  • Create and/or assist in the creation of materials and presentations and assist with logistical coordination of training events.
  • Performs other related duties as assigned.

Core Competencies

  • Knowledge of the principles and procedures related to HIV education and training.
  • Ability to develop curriculum for programs.
  • Ability to use standard office equipment, which includes a computer and projector.
  • Ability to analyze and develop action plans in resolving and/or implementing organizational and operational problems, issues and goals.
  • Competence in both oral and written English to communicate in a clear and concise manner.
  • Ability to establish and maintain effective and harmonious work relations with faculty, staff, students and customers.

Minimum Requirements

Bachelor’s Degree in related field with 2‑5 years of related experience. 10 years of related work experience may be substituted in lieu of educational qualifications.
